evals.expected_output: Reads all quickref files, identifies typography/style inconsistencies vs design tokens, plans fixes with shared helpers first, implements, verifies

evals.prompt: I just edited referenceConfigs.tsx, GenericReferenceView.tsx, and the ABG interpreter. Verify everything compiles.

evals.expected_output: Transpile check on referenceConfigs.tsx, safety grep for scoring system fields (whenNotToUse), import verification, clean report
